integrity: All results have a self-contained elementary argument and independently enumerated finite checks. The affine commutation criterion and foundational monoid context are attributed to relevant literature. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No formula for every finite ring; square-zero explicit four-size spectrum assumes cotangent dimension at least two; external novelty priority is provisional; none of the finite computational checks substitutes for the infinite proof.
title: Centralizer spectra of finite affine monoids distinguish local-ring geometry
